generation.prompt_exact:
Using the supplied first generated reference sheet only for the naturalistic pixel detail, ground-bath function and garden perspective, and the supplied second sheet for natural weathered cedar slat texture, author a NEW MODERN MINIMALIST garden collection production sheet. EXACTLY FOUR isolated complete placeable assets in a strict 2x2 grid: TOP LEFT concrete planter, TOP RIGHT modern slat seat, BOTTOM LEFT shallow rectangular concrete GROUND birdbath (a material/form variant of the source low ground bath), BOTTOM RIGHT modern slat privacy screen. Entire objects and their small contact shadows fit within the central 70 percent of their quadrant, with at least 90 transparent pixels clearance from each quadrant boundary. No overlap, cropping, labels, numbers, text, UI, birds, insects, plants, scenery or painted background. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside silhouettes and small contact shadows; no painted haze or backdrop.
Style: high-quality detailed naturalistic pixel art with crisp deliberate square pixel clusters and subtly dark pixel contours. Rich restrained material detail, no smooth airbrush/photographic noise, no chibi/cartoon. Consistent three-quarter side view with modest top visibility, warm upper-left daylight. A single coherent collection palette: matte charcoal powder-coated steel, warm pale-gray concrete, natural lightly weathered cedar slats, restrained sage-gray accents. Clean utilitarian forms, calm enough for birds to remain focus.
TOP LEFT: modern square low concrete planter, warm pale-gray cast concrete with fine subtle aggregate and a narrow softly beveled lip, dark dry bare soil visible in its square open cavity, small inset feet. No plant. Compact heavy believable proportions, no ornament.
TOP RIGHT: simple modern low garden seating bench, a broad flat seat of parallel natural cedar slats on two thin charcoal rectangular sled frames; no tall back, no armrests, no cushions, no storage shelf. A clearly designed seating object about 1.2m wide, matching the planter and screen, entire sled bases visible.
BOTTOM LEFT: shallow rectangular concrete GROUND birdbath, broad very low pale-gray cast-concrete tray with softly beveled rounded corners, gently sloped shallow interior, thin layer of clear blue-green still water with a restrained highlight, one small flat gray landing stone at one edge. No pedestal, fountain, plants, birds or separate accessory. Preserve low ground-bath function and scale family from the source; this is the rectangular_concrete visual variant, not a new canonical primary object.
BOTTOM RIGHT: modern freestanding slat privacy screen, a narrow upright charcoal rectangular outer frame holding sparse evenly spaced horizontal natural cedar slats, open transparent gaps, two compact stable low feet. No plants, fabric, wall, rail or vines. Match the modern bench's natural slats and charcoal frame. Entire frame and feet visible.
Only these four static flattened objects. No duplicated views, animation frames, diagrams, extra props or UI. Transparent beyond minimal contact shadows.
